notes.title: KosmoSquad v1.1 Released
notes.content:
We've been playing KosmoSquad a lot since the v1.0 release, both individually and together with RemotePlay. There were a variety of things that weren't game-breaking but that we really felt like should go in the game to make it a continually-enjoyable experience.

So, one week after launching the game on Steam, we are shipping a large collection of improvements that enhance the game experience. Steam should automatically update your game client and the game will display the version number on the title screen.

[h2]Quality-of-Life (QoL) Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Powerup now displays a shrinking bar indicating duration.
[*] Game now has onscreen keyboard entry for profile name (full controller support).
[*] Left/right now moves between UI columns on the level select screen.
[*] Unspent points now appear on the end game dialog.
[*] Lives remaining are now announced when a player dies.
[*] Minor update to button text to indicate that it will return players to upgrade screen.
[*] Game now announces when a new high-score has been achieved.
[*] Swapped position of current score and high score.
[*] Unlocked new level now specifies which level has been unlocked.
[*] Refresh rate dropdown now says "refresh/fps".
[*] Players can now toggle full screen from the pause menu.
[*] Added deadzone to settings with better default values.
[*] Deadzone is distance-based, not axis-based.
[*] When an enemy kills a player the enemy remains alive so it's clear how player died.
[*] Skull warning icon is now bigger for balloon enemies
[*] Early progression is a little faster.
[*] Alt-tabbing mid game now pauses.
[*] Improved clarity of unlock messages.
[*] Music no longer plays when game is not in focus.
[*] Game pauses when active controller is unplugged.
[*] Pressing B backs out of settings menu.
[*] Pressing B backs out of profile creation.
[*] Pressing B backs out of combo and list boxes.
[*] Pressing B returns to level in boss victory popup.
[*] Pressing B returns to level select on loss popup.
[*] Pressing B returns to game from pause menu.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where unjoined controller could select UI.
[*] Fixed case where level 4 could be cheesed by hanging out in corners.
[*] Fixed issue where game losing focus when fading in could cause black screen.
[*] Fixed "Unlocked Level 1" notification when starting a new game.
[*] Fixed game not pausing when Steam overlay is opened.
[*] Fixed alt-tabbing causing the game to think a controller disconnected.
[*] Fixed controller affecting game when game is backgrounded.
[*] Fixed disabled listbox items being selectable.
[/list]

There is one known issue: if multiple players die simultaneously, using up the last lives, the game can end while also respawning a player. This does not break the game and may be fixed in a future version.

Thanks to everyone who has bought and played the game. If you like the game, please leave us a review!

Sincerely,
[b]Justin and Vic[/b] - creators of KosmoSquad
